description: Search millions of active US car listings by make, model, year, price range, mileage, ZIP code, and radius. Returns VIN, price, miles, dealer info, Carfax status, and days on market. Filter by seller type (dealer/private) and color. Data from all major US marketplaces (MarketCheck)

radius.description: Search radius in miles from ZIP (max 100 on free tier)

zip.description: US ZIP code to search near (e.g. "10001")

name: vehicle.carmarket.search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Search Car Listings
